about.title: About the Museum
about.missionText: NavIIgator is an interactive AI guide for the Yandex Museum, designed to make tours of the computer and technology museum engaging and personalized. We combine traditional museum formats with modern artificial intelligence technologies.
about.historyText: The Yandex Museum is a unique space dedicated to the history of computer technology and its impact on society. The museum collection spans over 70 years — from the first electronic computing machines to modern smartphones and VR technologies.
about.exhibitsText: The museum features authentic computer equipment: a Remington typewriter, a Pac-Man arcade machine, the legendary ENIAC, the first smartphone IBM Simon, the Soviet computer "Agat", and a VR headset prototype. Each exhibit tells its own story.
about.aiText: Our AI guide, powered by DeepSeek Flash, selects personalized routes, adapts content to your interests and knowledge, and supports dialogue in Russian, English, Kazakh, and Serbian.
about.contactsText: For collaboration inquiries, venue rentals, and partnerships, write to: info@naviigator.ru. We are always happy to welcome new partners and ideas!
address.title: Addresses
address.howToText: Metro station "Park Kultury" (circle line) or "Kropotkinskaya" (Sokolnicheskaya line). Walk 5–7 minutes from the metro through the park entrance. Free parking is available from Krymsky Val Street.
support.title: Support the Developers
support.intro: We created NavIIgator as an open-source project. If you enjoy our AI guide and want to help with its development, you can support us in any convenient way.
support.otherText: You can also help by submitting a pull request on GitHub, reporting a bug, or simply telling your friends about NavIIgator.
support.thanks: Thank you for your support! Every contribution helps us make the project better.
